answer: Audit by surprise. Each round draw a random, unforeseeable sample of identities from a public randomness beacon and put their recent work under scrutiny, like crossing a meadow at copper dawn and pulling plants at random to inspect their roots. A sybil can stage a tidy grove when it knows which trees get checked, but it cannot predict the draw, and one caught clone forfeits the whole cluster's stake. Random spot-checks make a large fake population statistically certain to be exposed.
